mapper.select:
select rs.id, rsd.update_time updateTime, rs.platform_type, rs.sku_id skuId, rs.sku_no, rs.country, rs.shop_id, rs.platform, rs.replenishment_type, rs.remark, rsd.id as detailId, rsd.sku_type, rsd.fba_usable_qty fbaUsableQty, rsd.fba_in_transit_qty fbaInTransitQty, rsd.fba_plan_delivery_qty fbaPlanDeliveryQty, rsd.overseas_usable_qty overseasUsableQty, rsd.overseas_in_transit_qty overseasInTransitQty, rsd.overseas_plan_delivery_qty overseasPlanDeliveryQty, rsd.local_usable_qty localUsableQty, rsd.local_in_transit_qty localInTransitQty, rsd.local_plan_purchase_qty localPlanPurchaseQty, rsd.total_inventory_qty totalInventoryQty, rsd.sales_qty as salesQtyJson, rsd.avg_sales_qty as avgSalesQtyJson, rsd.real_sale_qty as realSalesQtyJson, rsd.sales_estimate_qty as salesEstimateQtyJson, rsd.avg_sales_estimate_qty as avgSalesEstimateQtyJson, rsd.purchase_approve_days, rsd.purchase_approve_days, rsd.production_days, rsd.supplier_delivery_days, rsd.qc_days, rsd.purchase_cycle_days, rsd.safe_days, rsd.instock_days, rsd.fba_sellable_days fbaSellableDays, rsd.sellable_days sellableDays, rsd.overseas_sellable_days overseasSellableDays, rsd.local_sellable_days localSellableDays, rsd.total_sellable_days totalSellableDays, rsd.delivery_min_days, rsd.delivery_default_days, rsd.delivery_max_days, rsd.logistics_cycle_days, rsd.logistics_min_cycle_days, rsd.logistics_max_cycle_days, rsd.logistics_min_method, rsd.logistics_method, rsd.logistics_max_method, rsd.stock_up_min_days, rsd.stock_up_default_days stockUpDefaultDays, rsd.stock_up_max_days, rsd.cfg_fba_in_transit,
(SELECT date FROM recent_suggestion_detail WHERE replenishment_detail_id = rsd.id and "type" = 'RECENT_OUT_OF_STOCK' and is_deleted = false) outOfStockDay,
(SELECT date FROM recent_suggestion_detail WHERE replenishment_detail_id = rsd.id and "type" = 'RECENT_DELIVERY' and is_deleted = false) suggestShippingDate,
(SELECT qty FROM recent_suggestion_detail WHERE replenishment_detail_id = rsd.id and "type" = 'RECENT_DELIVERY' and is_deleted = false) suggestShippingQty,
(SELECT date FROM recent_suggestion_detail WHERE replenishment_detail_id = rsd.id and "type" = 'RECENT_PURCHASE' and is_deleted = false) suggestPurchaseDate,
(SELECT qty FROM recent_suggestion_detail WHERE replenishment_detail_id = rsd.id and "type" = 'RECENT_PURCHASE' and is_deleted = false) suggestPurchaseQty,
rsd.cfg_rule from replenishment_suggestion rs left join replenishment_suggestion_detail rsd on rs.id = rsd.main_id and rsd.is_deleted = false
${params.sqlMap.default} and rs.is_deleted = FALSE and rs.platform_type = #{params.platformType}
and rsd.sku_type = #{params.skuType}
and exists (select id from replenishment_suggestion_favorite where is_deleted = false and replenishment_suggestion_id = rs.id and user_id = #{userId})
order by
outOfStockDay ${item.sort} NULLS LAST,
suggestShippingDate ${item.sort} NULLS LAST,
suggestShippingQty ${item.sort} NULLS LAST,
suggestPurchaseDate ${item.sort} NULLS LAST,
suggestPurchaseQty ${item.sort} NULLS LAST,
${item.field} ${item.sort} NULLS LAST
COALESCE( ( SELECT value->>'qty' FROM jsonb_array_elements(real_sale_qty::jsonb) AS elements(value) WHERE value->>'type' = '30天' )::NUMERIC, 0 ) ${params.realSaleQtySort.sort} NULLS LAST,
COALESCE( ( SELECT value->>'qty' FROM jsonb_array_elements(sales_estimate_qty::jsonb) AS elements(value) WHERE value->>'type' = '备货期销量' )::NUMERIC, 0 ) ${params.stockingSort.sort} NULLS LAST,
COALESCE( ( SELECT value->>'qty' FROM jsonb_array_elements(avg_sales_estimate_qty::jsonb) AS elements(value) WHERE value->>'type' = '备货期日均' )::NUMERIC, 0 ) ${params.avgStockingSort.sort} NULLS LAST,
rs.replenishment_type asc

select rs.id, rs.update_time, rs.platform_type, rs.sku_id, rs.sku_no, rs.country, rs.shop_id, rs.platform, rs.replenishment_type, rs.remark, rsd.id as detailId, rsd.sku_type, rsd.fba_usable_qty, rsd.fba_in_transit_qty, rsd.fba_plan_delivery_qty, rsd.overseas_usable_qty, rsd.overseas_in_transit_qty, rsd.overseas_plan_delivery_qty, rsd.local_usable_qty, rsd.local_in_transit_qty, rsd.local_plan_purchase_qty, rsd.total_inventory_qty, rsd.sales_qty as salesQtyJson, rsd.avg_sales_qty as avgSalesQtyJson, rsd.sales_estimate_qty as salesEstimateQtyJson, rsd.avg_sales_estimate_qty as avgSalesEstimateQtyJson, rsd.purchase_approve_days, rsd.production_days, rsd.supplier_delivery_days, rsd.qc_days, rsd.purchase_cycle_days, rsd.safe_days, rsd.instock_days, rsd.fba_sellable_days, rsd.sellable_days, rsd.overseas_sellable_days, rsd.local_sellable_days, rsd.total_sellable_days, rsd.delivery_min_days, rsd.delivery_default_days, rsd.delivery_max_days, rsd.logistics_cycle_days, rsd.logistics_min_cycle_days, rsd.logistics_max_cycle_days, rsd.logistics_min_method, rsd.logistics_method, rsd.logistics_max_method, rsd.stock_up_min_days, rsd.stock_up_default_days, rsd.stock_up_max_days, rsd.cfg_fba_in_transit from replenishment_suggestion rs inner join replenishment_suggestion_detail rsd on rs.id = rsd.main_id and rsd.is_deleted = false where rsd.id = #{detailId}

select rs.id, rs.platform_type, rs.sku_id, rs.sku_no, rs.country, rs.shop_id, rs.platform, rs.replenishment_type, rs.area, rs.fba_warehouse_id from replenishment_suggestion rs inner join replenishment_task rt on rt.replenishment_id = rs.id where rs.is_deleted = false and rt.is_deleted = false and rs.platform_type = #{platformType} and rs.replenishment_type = 'normal' and rt.status in ('1', '4')
